description.mn: Acqua di Parma Sakura: Unisex цитрус үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: бергамот, мандарин, ягаан чинжүү.
description.en: Acqua di Parma's Sakura Eau de Parfum is a unisex Citrus scent, unveiled in 2019. Its composition begins with top notes of zesty Calabrian bergamot, vibrant Yellow Mandarin, and a hint of spicy Pink Pepper. The heart of the fragrance blooms with delicate Cherry Blossom and exotic Jasmine Sambac, while a warm base of Musk rounds out the olfactory experience.
